title: Clean release C4 replay
target: Three warmed four-stream 16K-class staggered replay measurements

provenance: The candidate is the clean public-source reconstruction of the original-project 4b237597 optimization plus the original-project c805318 launcher fix.
The historical comparison image and clean image were inspected locally; raw/source-parity.json records their immutable identities and file-level parity boundary.
No external optimization was introduced by this measurement bundle.

configuration.warmup: startup shape sweep plus fatal four-resident-stream capacity gate; benchmark server reused across all three retained repetitions

gates.summary: scripts/check.sh all passed for the clean candidate before the full image build; the checksum-bound result commit reruns the same gate.
This bundle introduces no operator change; it measures the already reconstructed default.
No new engine change is being promoted by this measurement. Earlier tinyGLM evidence remains legacy evidence.
Only three C4 16K-class repetitions were collected, without paired run order or the remaining frozen cases.
No endurance, failure, or rollback campaign was run.

limitations: This is a reconstruction baseline measurement, not a paired candidate-versus-baseline experiment.
Only the C4 16K-class video workload was run; the complete frozen G3 matrix was not run.
The prompt generator produced 15,806-15,809 actual tokens, not exactly 16,384 tokens.
No G4 semantic-quality suite was run.
The historical and clean images use the same posted runtime profile but are not byte-identical; raw/source-parity.json records the boundary.
The server manifest was captured after result files made the checkout dirty; the image itself was built from the clean candidate commit and is identified by digest.
